The release where the SEC repository opens with a free trial, and robosystems.ai says what the platform is: the open-source knowledge graph for finance. Since v1.5.0 (November 1, 2026) a new account can try the SEC repository for 14 days without a card, the app explains the trial at every step from sign-up to the first charge, and the public site leads with the account instead of the meeting. The series went out as eight patch releases; this file is the account of it as a whole.

## 🔎 The SEC repository free trial

- **A 14-day trial, with no card.** The pricing page and the browse screen offer the trial on both SEC plans. It covers the analysis tools over MCP and the API; raw Cypher, the AI analyst and the monthly credits open with the first payment. It starts once the account's email is verified (#537, #548)
- **A banner says where the trial stands.** On Home, Repository Subscriptions and a repository's getting-started page, a running trial shows the date it ends and what opens with the plan. Without a card on file it says nothing is charged if the trial simply ends, with an Add a Card button that opens the billing portal; with one, it names the first charge and its date. Start Plan Now ends the trial early behind a confirm that states the charge (#537, #538, #548, #551)
- **The trial is mentioned on the way in:** on sign-up, on the consent page an MCP client lands on when it connects to the SEC repository without a subscription, and on an empty Home (#552)
- **A trial or subscription that has ended reads as ended.** One that ended at once (an immediate cancel, or a trial ended at Stripe) no longer shows as running or as "Cancelling" until its period end, on Home, the Organization page's Subscriptions tab and Repository Subscriptions. End dates are read as UTC throughout, so a seat that just ended offers Subscribe again in every time zone (#553, #554)
- **A refused trial keeps its reason on the page,** with a link to resend the verification email, instead of a toast that fades (#554)
- **A repository row on Home no longer shows schema-extension badges.** The SEC repository's row read "roboledger", as if it were a RoboLedger product (#551)

## 🌐 Public site

- **robosystems.ai leads with the open-source knowledge graph for finance.** The title, descriptions, `llms.txt` and structured data carry the new positioning, and the offer is named the Finance AI Deployment (#542, #550)
- **The hero states the choice a company has:** keep your ERP and your books where they are, or keep your books on RoboLedger; either way the AI works from a knowledge graph of them (#556)
- **The account is the primary button, the meeting the second.** Register (or Open app) takes the accent button in the header and hero; Book 20 minutes sits beside it and goes through `/book` (#542, #549)
- **A blog post can carry a video,** shown above the article and its audio (#536)
- **Terms of Service:** a repository subscription is held per user and billed to the organization, and AI credits are allocated on the first day of each calendar month (UTC), independent of the billing date. Last revised November 17, 2026 (#547)
- **Copy matches what ships:** private-company positions in the investor copy, one trial label and one contact label across the site, and a founder bio update (#544, #546, #550)

## 🐛 Bug fixes

- **A CDN failure keeps the last good sitemap** instead of serving one without the blog and docs URLs until the next regeneration (#529)
- **Table headers are valid markup again** on Activity, Backups, Home, Organization billing and Subgraphs (#534)

## 🔧 Infrastructure

- **`@robosystems/client` 2.35.0 → 2.42.0.** Operation streams are read over `fetch` with the credential in a header, in place of `EventSource` with a token in the URL. **`@robosystems/core` 0.19.0 → 0.21.7,** carrying the trial screens, the banner slot on Repository Subscriptions, and the docs catalog and renderer the app now reads from core (#528, #533, #539, #541, #551, #554, #555)
- **Next 16.4.6** and the Node 26.13.1 image base (#540, #543)
- **CI:** `setup-uv` moves to v10.3.3, pinned by SHA (#532)
- **For forks and self-hosters:** the development stack's S3 server is on port 8333 (#535)

## 📦 Deploy notes

- **The API goes first.** `@robosystems/client` 2.42.0 sends queries that robosystems v1.24.0 is the first release to serve in full; deploy this app after that API release is live.
- **No CloudFormation changes and no new variables or secrets.**
